translation.name: Deus Harere Aibaky Sesus mymyspirikpoko naha

book.name: Mateus
book.title: Mateus wasaniha ty ziwatahaka Sesus soho

content: Deus Sesus zihyrizikpowy.
Kyze petok zuruze, sabado ziharamuze kykyryk iytyk bo niukuruzonaha. Domiko miwa botu Maria Madarena ustatsa Maria kino niwatihi iytyk bo zumuzonaha.
Atsoko wytyk nitydydydykyktu. Iwaze bijoikpe iknykta Deus tsumuẽhĩtsa inasik harahare bobyri zipetu ibete nidyhyky.
Bijoikpe iknykta tisukbarazarẽta katsaktsa ibarazabaharẽta batu mynyhy. Paiparezo mykaranaha ihyrikoso waha bijoikpe myze iwa bijoikpe iknykta wata my.
Sodadutsa ipokso mytydydykyknaha. Sipybyrẽtsa nikaranaha iwatsahi wytyk bo inarahanaha. Siakbatsa watsa niyziknaha.
Bijoikpe iknykta kykyryk pe niy: — Ahapyby byihu ja! Sesus iharapatawyhyta humo nihyrikosokdata tsipiberikinaha ana kino kanymyrẽta.
Atakta iytyk eze hana bo ja. Hawa botu niy nahyrizikpo. Iktsataha isapy bo anaeze nihoeke.
Aidytyktsa! Nabo zinymyrykynahatsa bo tynakozorenahaktsa! ispe tsimaha: “O inahyrizikpo aharaze Karireja bo my, nabo ibo iktsa tsimaha. Aba tsipinynaha”. Kaharere tsiwabyziunaha — niy.
Iwaze iytyk ekze nitururuknaha. O Sesus nahyrizikpo sakurẽza nikaranaha. Sipybyrẽza nikaranaha Sesus tuk zinymyrykynahatsa pe aidy niaha.
Atsoko Sesus nisihobyk: — Awy ahapyby byihu ja! Ahapunihikrẽtsaktsa! — niy. Kykyryk ibo zumunahaze ipyrytsa humo paik paik niaha. — Ikia tsamysapyrẽta ahumo zuba mykurẽza — niaha.
— Ahapyby byihu ja! Zinymyrykynahatsa bo katuk kytsa bo tsimahaktsa! Ispe tsimaha: “Karireja bo tsimaha nabo kabo iktsa tsimaha” tsimaha — Sesus niy.
Sodadutsa Sesus nury soho mybarapetu nikaranaha.

Iwaze wytykyryk ske buruk niukurunahaze wastuhu sodadutsa, asahi iytyk ziharaperykynaha sihudikhudikwy bo ziksizonaha. Hawa ty nikara Deus wahoro zubata ziknapamykysokonahatsa taparaktsa bo nipamykysokonaha.
Kyze taparaktsa ziknapamykysokonahatsa taparaktsa ypykytsa bo niaha. Asa zuba inapamykysonaha. — Hawa sa tsimaha — nikaranaha. Iwaze tsizubarẽna okyrysaro ty sodadutsa bo nyny niaha.

Ispe niaha: — Ikiahatsaktsa kytsa pe “Unata eze tsikurunahaze iwaze zinymyrykynahatsa izumunaha inury zibykyknaha” tsimaha iwa kytsa bo tytsaso — niaha. Yhỹ niaha. Iwa humo okyrysaro ty sodadutsa bo nyny niaha.

Homa pehatsaktsa Piratus taharere piwaby zeka, katsaktsa ipe: — Sodadutsa wasani maha tsimaha. Iwa ahahumo batu takyri, iperykynahatsa sõtutsarẽtsa tuze batu takyri myharere humo. Iwatsahi mytsaty mytsaty byijataha! — ziknapamykysokonahatsa niaha.

Iwaze Sudeutsa perykynahatsa okyrysaro tsizubarẽna ziaksenaha. Hawa ha ty ziknapamykysokonahatsa sibo nitsasonaha atsatu ziknapamykysokonaha. Sudeutsa anaharere bo yhỹ mykaranaha abaka bo yhỹ mykaranaha.
Sesus tuktsa nisipehahik kytsa aparakbaha bo Deus wasania ty motsasonaha.
Kyze zinymyrykynahatsa õse Karireja bo niukurunaha. Hara bo nidokoknaha. Anaeze Sesus botu nitsaso nabo izumunaha.

Sesus bo inakozonahaze iokeryk taekaratsa humo puruk puruk niaha. — O ikia tsamysapyrẽta tsimy ikia humo mykurẽtsa — ipe nikaranaha. Wastuhu kytsa — O inahyrizikpo ja batu kanyhy nikaranaha. — Ustsa kytsa sihyrinymyrẽtsa nikaranaha ihumo sispirikporẽtsa.
Sesus sipauk baze tu natakaha ispe niy: — Kanamy tsizubarẽna, bijoikpe eze tu mysipehaka, mybarawy eze tu mysipehaka tsizubarẽna ty Deus kabo nyny niy.

Iwatahi aparakbaha naboktsa! Nanabyitaba tsimykurunaha ityryktsa aparakbaha bo wasanihaty tytsasonahaktsa! Katuktsa moziknaha tsipiksopykzukunaha kaharere bo yhỹ mykaranaha. Iwaze mysiharasusukunahaze Deus inaokota tytsasonaha. Iharere humo mysiharasusukunaha Deus myzo, Deus tse, Deus hyrikoso iwa tytsasonaha.
Hawa botu zahahyrinymyry hyỹ tsimykaranaha atsatu tysihyrinymyrykynahaktsa! Ahatuk mynapykyryk pahatsumuẽhĩ mykara. Mybarawy nepykze ahapauk baze tu mykara tawahi mynapykyryk. Iwa hỹ — Sesus niy.
